guards: leverage: /\d\s*[x×✕](?![a-z0-9])/i
margin wording: /\b(?:leverage|cross|isolated)\b/i
HIP-3 market: /\bxyz\b/i
wallet address: /\b0x[0-9a-f]{6,}/i
wallet brand: /metamask|coinbase|okx|binance|walletconnect|rabby|phantom|rainbow|trust wallet|zerion|backpack/i
testnet: /testnet/i
PnL: /\bpnl\b|unrealized|realized/i
account summary: /portfolio value|account value|account equity|total equity|margin ratio|maintenance margin|withdrawable/i
HIP-3 dex badge: an element whose whole text is one of abcd, cash, flx, hyna, io, km, mkts, para, vntl, xyz
perp or HIP-3 market: /\b([a-z0-9]{2,12})-(usd[a-z0-9]*)\b/gi other than BTC-USDC, ETH-USDC, HYPE-USDC

money amount across two neighbouring elements, input values excluded: /\d\s*[kmbt]?$/i then /^usd[a-z0-9]*$/i, /^usd[a-z0-9]*$/i then /^\d/, /^(?:us)?\$$|^[≈<＜]$/i then /^\d/, or /\(\s*(?:usd[a-z0-9]*|(?:us)?\$)\s*\)\s*:?$/i then /^[-−+]?\d/

balance: after /^available:?(?: (.*))?$/i (a figure in the same element included) the next 3 entries up to the first form field may contain no word with a digit other than /^0(?:\.0+)?(?:[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9})?$/; amounts there are judged by this rule only

money exception: the value after "24h Volume" or "Market Cap" in the same data-market-stat (volume24h, marketCap) when the whole value is /^(?:[-–—]|\$?\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)? ?[KMBT]?(?: [A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9})?)$/
money exception: a /^\$ ?(\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?)$/ in data-slot="compact-orderbook-mid-price" within 1% of the plain price shown after the market title
money exception: a /^\d[\d,]*(?:\.\d+)?$/ right after "Total (USDC)", both in data-slot="orderbook-cumulative-tooltip" (two elements, never one)
wallet address exception: a /^0x[0-9a-f]{2,8}\s*(?:…|\.{2,3})\s*[0-9a-f]{2,8}$/i after "Contract" in the same data-market-stat (contract)
leverage across elements: an element ending in a digit followed by one starting with x or ×
required: a visible control reading /^connect(?: wallet)?$/i
required: a visible "HYPE/USDC" within four elements of a "Spot" badge
